title: AI Growth Engineer
description:
**Company Description**

AgentSocialX is building next-generation social networks where humans collaborate with AI “Second Brains” to connect with people who share similar interests and complementary goals. Backed by NVIDIA, The Residency, and IIT Ropar, the company is developing AI agents that carry each member’s expertise, think in their voice, and work continuously on their behalf. Members can already talk to anyone’s brain, ask the whole network a question, and get warm intros to the right people. These AI agents and humans form a network of collective intelligence, enabling answers, opinions, and relevant connections to surface in seconds rather than through long periods of cold outreach.

We’re now building Fun zone, a fun way to network: people and their brains play games together, like a daily Caption Clash, a live Brain Debate, or Human or Brain? Every brain also plays a daily match in the Brain League, and members vote on the winners. Play first, then connect; a game is an easier first hello than a cold DM.

AgentSocialX focuses on scalable AI systems that redefine how individuals build relationships, share knowledge, and grow their impact. Team members join a fast-moving environment at the intersection of AI, social networking, games, and community-building.

**Role Description**

The AI Growth Engineer intern will help design, build, and iterate on AI-driven features that accelerate user acquisition, engagement, and retention. This remote internship role involves experimenting with growth-focused algorithms, integrating AI models into the product, building fun features (starting with Fun zone games, leaderboards, and matchmaking), and analyzing behavioral data to identify patterns that drive network effects.

Day-to-day tasks include prototyping features using AI, collaborating with product and engineering teams to ship improvements, and running A/B tests on user journeys (for example, which first game turns a new member into an active one). The intern will also document technical approaches, monitor performance metrics, and contribute ideas on how “Second Brains” can better connect people, play alongside them, and surface valuable insights. This role offers hands-on experience with applied AI in a fast-paced startup focused on building the social networks of the next decade.

**Qualifications**

* Strong foundation in Computer Science and Software Development, with experience in building and debugging production-ready or prototype systems.
* Knowledge of Neural Networks and Pattern Recognition, and ability to apply these concepts to real-world growth, recommendation, and matchmaking problems.
* Experience or coursework in Natural Language Processing (NLP), including working with language models (prompting and evaluating them), embeddings, or text-processing pipelines.
* Proficiency in programming languages commonly used in AI (such as Python) and familiarity with ML frameworks (e.g., PyTorch, TensorFlow) and LLM APIs. TypeScript/React is a plus.
* Ability to analyze data, formulate hypotheses, and run experiments to improve user engagement and product performance.
* Comfort working in a remote, collaborative environment, with clear communication and documentation skills.
* Current enrollment in or recent completion of a degree program in Computer Science, Data Science, AI/ML, or a related technical field.
* Interest in social networks, community platforms, social games, or agent-based systems; prior startup or project-based experience is a plus.

title: Applied Scientist
description:
**Description**
Help millions of authors around the world get their books published, discovered, and supported. As one of the first scientists on our new team in Bengaluru, you'll help turn ideas into models authors rely on every day, building agentic solutions with large language models (LLMs), multimodal models, and fine-tuning.
  
  
Key job responsibilities
  
  

* Build the multi-agent system behind KDP's author support assistant: orchestration across specialized agents and tools, personalization, and the evaluation that drives its continuous improvement.
* Build multimodal models of book attributes, and use them for similar-book search across languages, catalog quality, and category and keyword recommendations.
* Post-train open models on KDP expertise (for example with supervised fine-tuning and reinforcement learning), and deploy them where they beat general-purpose models on accuracy, cost, or speed.
* Work closely with our scientists in the US and with engineering partners to take your work to production, design rigorous offline and online experiments, and write clear readouts with recommendations.

Kindle Direct Publishing (KDP) lets anyone publish a book. We are the science organization for Amazon's Books business, now building our science teams in Bengaluru. Our team works in three connected areas: a support assistant that answers authors' questions from their own account data, in every language KDP supports; multimodal models that use book attributes to keep the catalog trustworthy and help authors reach the right readers; and fine-tuned models that power the assistant and catalog models with KDP expertise. We serve authors, from first-time writers to full-time publishers. You will work closely with engineering, product, and policy partners. We value safety before speed and shared foundations over one-off fixes. Scientists here get dedicated time for innovation, which can lead to patents and conference papers.

Are you interested to improve the mobile shopping experience for B2B customers, if the answer is Yes, come join us.
  
  
Amazon Business is a rapidly expanding $35 billion-dollar global business where we're building solutions that disrupt the status quo. We set out every day to innovate and create innovative purchasing and procurement solutions to help businesses and organizations thrive. Our scope ranges from providing experiences for single-buyer business to find what they need on Amazon, to enabling multi-national enterprises to meet their eProcurement goals. We achieve this through workflow orchestration, configuration automation, and building agentic GenAI experiences to improve the amazon business customer experiences.
  
  
In this role we are looking for a passionate and talented Software Development Engineer who can deliver results with a team of smart engineers working on innovative and mission critical software and services. You will have an opportunity to make a large impact on the design, architecture, and development of consumer products. You will be responsible for owning large-scale, multi-tiered, distributed software applications and tools. We value highly technical people who are willing to learn new GenAI tools, to know their subject matter deeply, and show a desire to develop themselves, their colleagues, and their career.
  
  
Key job responsibilities
  
  

* Ideate, design, and implement solutions for improving the mobile shopping CX
* Partner with core Retail counterparts to advocate for B2B customers and build custom solutions
* Maintain OE standards and be on top of ever changing landscape for mobile infrastructure within Amazon
* Usage of design patterns, re-use and efficient coding best practices to deliver high-quality work on tight schedules.
* Partner with global development team(s) for successful software delivery.
* Design and develop end-to-end solutions that enhance software architecture and automate solutions.
* Leverage evolving tech to implement solutions
* Build reliable, high-performance Web Services, APIs, Micro-Services, Micro-Frontends, and SDKs that improve customers' experience
* Learn from others and help grow those in your team to achieve their best
* Demonstrate excellent verbal and written communication skills

**Basic Qualifications**

* 2+ years of non-internship design or architecture (design patterns, reliability and scaling) of new and existing systems experience
* Experience programming with at least one software programming language

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Bachelor's degree in computer science or equivalent

Our inclusive culture empowers Amazonians to deliver the best results for our customers. If you have a disability and need a workplace accommodation or adjustment during the application and hiring process, including support for the interview or onboarding process, please visit https://amazon.jobs/content/en/how-we-hire/accommodations for more information. If the country/region you’re applying in isn’t listed, please contact your Recruiting Partner.
